Robinhood (HOOD) chief investment officer Stephanie Guild and Miller Tabak managing director and equity strategist Matt Maley join Opening Bid Host Brian Sozzi to discuss why rising capex has become a key concern for the market.

items.title: Is Riot Platforms (RIOT) Too Pricey For Its AI Data Center Push?
items.summary: Riot Platforms has delivered a 59.1% gain year to date, yet the stock screens as expensive on broader valuation checks. This raises the question of how much of the AI data center story is already reflected in the current price. Year to date, Riot Platforms is up 59.1%, which indicates investors have already priced in a meaningful shift in sentiment toward the stock. The expanded AI and high performance computing leasing opportunity tied to AMD and Anthropic can support long term revenue...
